sources.quote: The notice should state that you (a) are holding the property and; (b) are required to deliver the property to the Comptroller’s office by July 1 if they do not claim their property.

requiredLanguage.todo: Official text found (2026-10-29): the 2026 Reporting Instructions say the notice 'must include the following language' - (1) the holder is holding the property; (2) the holder may be required to deliver it to the Comptroller's office on or before July 1 if not claimed (mirrors § 74.1011). It is written in second person to the HOLDER ('You (the holder)'), so it is a content requirement, not owner-facing verbatim text; the How-to-File page words (2) as 'are required to deliver'. Left null pending a human decision on the owner-facing wording (e.g. 'We are holding your property ... we may be required to deliver it to the Texas Comptroller on or before July 1 if it is not claimed'). Filling it makes TX letters compose as ready; src/lib/letters/compose.test.ts currently asserts TX is null. Postage may be charged against the property (> $250 items).
